Top highlights
  • WHOLESOME AND NUTRITIOUS: Our Artisan Vegan Salami is not only delicious but also a wholesome choice. With over 16g of protein per serving, Renegade Foods salami provides a protein-packed option that is low in fat and sugar. Plus, it contains 50% less sodium than traditional salami, promoting a healthier lifestyle.
  • CONVENIENT AND SUSTAINABLE: Unlike many other plant-based proteins options, Renegade Foods salami is shelf-stable and requires no refrigeration until after opening. This makes it perfect for on-the-go snacking, picnics, or creating impressive charcuterie boards. By eliminating the need for cold storage or shipping, our salami is eco-friendly and sustainable.
  • CRAFTED WITH PASSION: Renegade Foods has dedicated years to perfecting our 100% plant based food, a premium chef-made vegan salami. We meticulously source organic ingredients and employ traditional techniques like smoking to bring you the authentic flavors and textures of legendary European charcuterie.
  • EXCITING SAMPLER PACK: Experience the ultimate plant-based food, charcuterie, with Renegade Foods Artisan Vegan Salami Trio Sampler Pack. This pack includes three 7.5oz plant-based salami, each showcasing a unique and mouthwatering signature flavor: Smoky Soppressata, Sweet Toscana, and Spicy Chorizo.
  • ENDLESS CULINARY POSSIBILITIES: Let your creativity shine with Renegade Artisan Vegan Salami Trio. Elevate your charcuterie boards, craft delectable sandwiches or scrambles, or add a burst of flavor to pastas and stir-fries. The possibilities are limitless, and the taste is extraordinary.

    USDA Organic

    USDA Organic certified products are required to be produced using farming practices that maintain and improve soil and water quality, reduce the use of synthetic materials, conserve biodiversity, and avoid genetic engineering, among other factors. Crops can be certified organic if they're grown without prohibited substances such as most synthetic fertilizers and pesticides for three years prior to harvest. Livestock are raised on pastures and treated humanely without growth hormones or antibiotics. Organic products do not contain GMOs or artificial colours, flavours or preservatives. USDA Organic products contain a minimum of 95% organic ingredients and use the USDA Organic seal.

Product Description

Indulge in the tantalizing flavors of Renegade Foods Artisan Vegan Salami Trio Sampler Pack. This carefully curated pack features three 7.5oz plant-based salami, each representing a unique signature flavor: Smoky Soppressata, Sweet Toscana, and Spicy Chorizo. Renegade Foods has poured passion and expertise into perfecting our 100% plant-based, premium vegan salami. We've meticulously selected organic ingredients and harnessed traditional techniques like smoking to deliver the authentic taste and texture of legendary European charcuterie. Each bite of Renegade Artisan Vegan Salami is a wholesome delight. With over 16g of protein per serving, it provides a protein-packed option that is low in fat and sugar. Additionally, it contains 50% less sodium than traditional salami, offering a healthier choice for mindful eating. One of the standout features of Renegade salami is its convenience. Our shelf-stable salami requires no refrigeration until after opening, making it ideal for on-the-go snacking, outdoor adventures, or creating impressive charcuterie boards. By eliminating the need for cold storage or shipping, our salami contributes to a more eco-friendly and sustainable future. Unlock your culinary creativity with Renegade Artisan Vegan Salami Trio. Elevate your charcuterie boards with its delectable flavors, reimagine your favorite sandwiches or scrambles, or add a burst of savory goodness to pastas and stir-fries. The possibilities are endless, and the taste is extraordinary. Each Renegade Foods product is made with love and artistry in small batches in Sonoma Wine Country, CA. We take pride in using clean, organic ingredients to deliver an exceptional plant-based salami experience. Embark on a flavorful journey and savor the goodness of Renegade Foods.
